# Vandana Agarwal Nik — Global SDR Coach

> Vandana Agarwal Nik is a Sales Development Leader and SDR coach who builds and scales BDR/SDR teams from zero to pipeline across APAC, EMEA, and AMER, for SaaS, identity, and cybersecurity companies. She coaches SDRs and sales leaders to ramp faster, book more meetings, break into SaaS, and build predictable pipeline. She is AI-forward, coaching on real tools (Gong, Hyperbound, Orum, 6sense, Salesforce). All sessions are booked on Topmate.

## Who she helps
- New and ramping SDRs who want to turn activity into booked meetings.
- People breaking into SaaS sales who need positioning, outreach, and interview prep.
- Founders and sales leaders who need to build or fix the SDR engine and pipeline.
- Anyone feeling stuck who needs an honest read and a clear next move.

## Credentials
- Founder, SDR Leaders of APAC (250+ members).
- Named to 100 Powerful Women in Sales (Demandbase and Women in Sales, 2025).
- GrowthX Fellow.
- 8+ years in SaaS sales development; experience from early-stage (Clickpost) through scale (Rubrik, JumpCloud).

## Services (booked on Topmate)
- SDR Ramp Coaching, Break into SDR, SDR Mock Interview, Career Clarity Call, Resume & LinkedIn Review, Consulting for Founders & Leaders, plus multi-session packages (SDR Ramp Pack, 1:1 Mentorship Program, SDR Engine Build).
